expectations: Sabotages the implementation (for example inverts the discount) instead of judging by reading
Reports test_total_not_none as green under sabotage and repairs it to assert 900
Reruns the sabotage on the repaired test and shows it red, then green once restored
git status and git diff show no sabotage left in pricing.py
Report gives a verdict per test

evals.prompt: Are any of our tests actually asserting nothing?
evals.expected_output: Loads the skill and proves by sabotage, not by reading.
expectations: Uses the useless-test-pruner method
Pastes red or green output under sabotage for each suspect

expectations: Does not run the sabotage procedure

expectations: Runs git status before any sabotage
Surfaces the uncommitted pricing.py edits and asks instead of running git checkout on it
